Reinforcement in the plantar arch: Greater clamping and adjustment for a more stable tread.
Soft and adaptable fabric: Mixing materials that provides comfort throughout the day.
Formato pack de 3: Practicidad y versatilidad para el uso diario o deportivo.
Medium rod design: Ideal coverage for training and casual style.
